Workshop Overview

Connect. Learn. Experience the Coast.

The PAL Coastal Workshop brings together Louisiana port professionals, industry partners, and invited guests for an immersive look at the people, operations, and coastal environment shaping Port Fourchon.

Over three days, attendees will gather for meals, fishing, port presentations and tours, the PAL Board Meeting, and the kind of informal conversations that make this annual workshop valuable.

Why Port Fourchon

The Hub of the Gulf Coast

The workshop puts attendees directly in one of Louisiana's most important maritime and energy hubs.

250+companies use Port Fourchon as a base of operation
95%of Gulf deepwater energy production is serviced by Port Fourchon
15K+people per month are flown to supported offshore locations
400+large supply vessels traverse the port's channels each day
